title: Normalized direct image of strict semilinear coefficient systems
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension and $f:X\to Y$ a scheme morphism, using independent site and coefficient universes. For every coefficient comparison C of [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models] and every normalized right derived image T of the levelwise completed-module tower pushforward along C.structureMap, StrictImageData f C T of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-strict-image-data] is nonempty. In particular, the strict-system comparison is constructed before evaluation and has identity underlying sections in every degree, with its universal-unit normalization. No inverse-limit comparison or tower-evaluation comparison is claimed.

proof.text: Construct only the ordinary additive strict-system direct image, its finite evaluation comparisons and the ordinary completed-tower comparison with identity sections. These data do not yet include any derived functor.

Transfer the Grothendieck property across coefficientSystemEquivalence to the actual coefficient-system category. Apply totalDerivedData to its additive systemPush, obtaining a right derived functor, universal unit and K-injective computation.

Use systemRestriction_push_acyclic for the supplied source restriction and towerImage. This supplies precisely the second acyclicity hypothesis of the generic derivedCoefficientComparison. Apply that proved generic comparison to the ordinary square and the supplied exact source and target factors.

Precompose the generic normalization equation with the target factor isomorphism and postcompose with towerImage applied to the source factor isomorphism. Cancel each factor against its inverse and use functoriality to obtain Square.normalization. Assemble StrictImageData, retaining the ordinary section identities.

theorem strictImage_exists {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (C : CoefficientComparisonData l E f)
    (towerImage : RightImage
      ((Functor.whiskeringRight ℕᵒᵖ _ _).obj (push f C.structureMap))) :
    Nonempty (StrictImageData l E f C towerImage)
